Let's search memory: In ta4j 0.15 maybe BaseBarSeriesBuilder has method withNumTypeOf(Class) and withNumValues(Num...). I think method is withNumValues(Num...). Let's assume correct method name is withNumValues(Num...). We'll replace with withNumValues.

Also need to import JUnit4's @Before, @Test, etc. Already imported org.junit.* includes Before, Test, etc. So we can keep.
